answer: Each identity claims a terrace plot and locks a 70-credit bond. Filing needs a delay chain from a jade token: 3,600 steps, each sealing the next; no machine can parallelize it. An auditor replays the chain and checks the velvet seal on the plot key; a rented-delay ring copying chains burns the bond. First filing 44, k-th 44+9(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 4,539,500 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent runs one chain, pays 44 once, keeps its bond.
